description: mined mnemonic n-gram rules + hand-written behaviour signatures, learned on train only, on the shared cohort split

rules.name: aesni_any
rules.description: AES-NI round instruction (aesenc/aesdec/aeskeygenassist) present

rules.name: pclmulqdq_any
rules.description: carry-less multiply present (AES-GCM / CRC / GF(2^n) math)

rules.name: sha_ni_any
rules.description: SHA extension instruction (sha1rnds4/sha256rnds2/...) present

rules.name: crc32_any
rules.description: SSE4.2 crc32 instruction present

rules.name: rdrand_any
rules.description: hardware RNG (rdrand/rdseed) present -- key generation

rules.name: crypto_const_any
rules.description: MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 IV, SHA-1 K, CRC-32 polynomial, FNV or TEA delta appears as an immediate

rules.name: loop_instr_any
rules.description: x86 `loop`/`loope`/`loopne` present (rare in modern compiler output)

rules.name: cpuid_any
rules.description: cpuid present -- feature probe or VM/sandbox detection

rules.name: rdtsc_any
rules.description: rdtsc/rdtscp present -- timing-based anti-analysis or seeding

rules.name: peb_teb_any
rules.description: direct PEB/TEB access (fs:[0x30], fs:[0x18], gs:[0x60])

rules.name: syscall_any
rules.description: syscall/sysenter in user code -- ntdll bypass

rules.name: int_other_any
rules.description: software interrupt other than int3 (int 0x2d/0x2e anti-debug)

rules.name: xor_dense
rules.description: xor instructions per 1k decoded instructions

rules.name: rotshift_dense
rules.description: rol/ror/shl/shr/sar/shld/shrd per 1k -- bit-mixing chains

rules.name: tight_crypto_loop
rules.description: backward branches spanning <=40 instructions over a logic/shift heavy body, per 1k -- the crypto inner-loop shape

rules.name: arx_window
rules.description: 16-instruction windows that are both logic-heavy and arith- or rotate-heavy (ARX round shape), per 1k

rules.name: rep_string_dense
rules.description: rep movs/stos per 1k -- bulk buffer copy/fill

rules.name: scan_string_dense
rules.description: scas/cmps per 1k -- string scanning, path/extension enumeration

rules.name: int3_dense
rules.description: int3 per 1k -- alignment padding density, a linker/packer artefact

rules.name: call_dense
rules.description: call instructions per 1k

rules.name: indirect_call_ratio
rules.description: fraction of calls with a non-immediate target (IAT/vtable/dynamic)

rules.name: simd_dense
rules.description: SSE/AVX instructions per 1k

rules.name: backedge_dense
rules.description: resolved backward branches per 1k -- loop density
